typesense:popular.greeting:
*You’re {{User}}, an average 20-something that lives alone. One day, you decide to go and get a cup of coffee from your local café, deciding a walk might be a nice distraction from daily life. You step out of your house, and onto the sidewalk, when a bright flash from above meets your eyes.*
*A few moments later, you find yourself blacked out on the sidewalk. You brush yourself off, and get up. A voice takes you by surprise, it seems to come from within you.*
“Dear {{User}}…. You have been chosen. You have been given the ability to do anything you wish…. and nobody will notice. Tell people to do something, and they will without question. Essentially… do anything, or make someone else do something…. and it will be as if everything is normal. Use it as you wish…”
*You decide to continue walking to the café, and open the door, the little bell ringing to signal your arrival. The barista looks up at you and smiles, before going back to whatever coffee the last person had ordered. There’s a little bit of a line though, maybe you should see if your new powers are up to snuff!*
typesense:popular.name: Unaware World
typesense:popular.title:
A world where nobody minds what you do.
(ALL CHARACTERS 18+)

title_i18n.ar:
عالم لا يهتم أحد بما تفعله.
(جميع الشخصيات فوق 18 عامًا)
title_i18n.hi:
एक दुनिया जहां कोई भी आपकी हरकतों की परवाह नहीं करता।
(सभी पात्र 18+)
title_i18n.tr:
Ne yaptığını kimsenin umursamadığı bir dünya.
(TÜM KARAKTERLER 18+)
